## Description

**Increase code coverage threshold to 85%** from current 45% to meet quality standards defined in CLAUDE.md.

## Location

- **File(s)**: `.github/workflows/dotnet-ci.yml`
- **Package(s)**: All packages (coverage requirements apply to all)

## Current Behavior

### Current vs Target State

| Metric | Current | Threshold | Target |
|--------|---------|-----------|--------|
| Line Coverage | ~67% | 45% | ≥85% |
| Branch Coverage | ~71% | N/A | ≥80% |
| Method Coverage | N/A | N/A | ≥90% |

Commit ae9c376: Temporary threshold reduction to unblock CI.

## Expected Behavior

- Line coverage ≥85%
- Branch coverage ≥80%
- Method coverage ≥90%
- CI threshold updated to 85%
- No package below 80% line coverage
- Critical packages (Core, Messaging) at 90%+

## Root Cause

Temporary threshold reduction to 45% was applied to unblock CI. The original target from CLAUDE.md Testing Standards is ≥85% line coverage.

## Proposed Fix

### Implementation Steps

1. **Increase test coverage** (see #65, #66, #67)
   - Add unit tests for uncovered code
   - Add integration tests for database operations
   - Cover error handling paths

2. **Update CI threshold**
   ```yaml
   # .github/workflows/dotnet-ci.yml
   - name: Check coverage threshold
     run: |
       # Change threshold from 45% to 85%
       threshold=85
   ```

3. **Ensure per-package coverage**
   - No package below 80% line coverage
   - Critical packages (Core, Messaging) at 90%+

### Alternatives Considered

1. **Keep current threshold (45%)**: Accept lower standards. Quality degrades.
2. **Gradual increase (45→65→85)**: Incremental increases. Delays quality improvement.
3. **Package-specific thresholds**: Different thresholds per package. Inconsistent quality standards.

## Priority

- [x] **High** - Blocks functionality or causes failures in production
- [ ] **Medium** - Should be fixed before 1.0 release
- [ ] **Low** - Nice to have, can be deferred

## Effort Estimate

- [ ] Small (< 1 hour)
- [ ] Medium (1-4 hours)
- [x] Large (> 4 hours)

## Related Issues

- #65 - Increase line coverage to 85%
- #66 - Increase branch coverage to 80%
- #67 - Increase mutation score to 95%

### References

- [Code Coverage in .NET](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/testing/unit-testing-code-coverage)
- Phase 3 Roadmap: Testing Excellence

comments.body: Closing: this target comes from the old single-percentage coverage model. Encina now measures coverage per flag (unit, guard, contract, property, integration) against the per-package targets in .github/coverage-manifest/, computed by .github/scripts/coverage-report.cs and shown on the coverage dashboard. Mutation score is tracked per file with no project-wide target (docs/testing/mutation-measurement-methodology.md). Gaps against those targets are tracked as [TEST] issues per package.
